plugin.plugin_minesweeper.name: Minesweeper
plugin.plugin_minesweeper.description: A mine bet on 24 fields: pick the mines, every diamond raises the multiplier, 🔥 cashes out.
plugin.plugin_minesweeper.setting.rtp_hi: 100 = a fair game; below it the house keeps the rest (e.g. 95).
plugin.plugin_minesweeper.setting.curren: One of the currencies of the Economy module; empty: the default one. Bets, wins and fines use this currency, and the answers show its name.
plugin.plugin_minesweeper.node.play.desc: Takes the bet and posts the field.
